name: ui-platform
description: UI application creation, discovery, preview, settings, export, deletion, and maintenance platform.

scripts.test:composition: npm run build && vitest run tests/application-composition.test.ts && node scripts/test-application-composition.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @uib/platform-core && npm run build --workspace @ui-platform/artifacts && npm run build --workspace @ui-platform/visual-artifacts && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @ui-platform/visual-artifacts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/platform-core/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @ui-platform/artifacts
scripts.test:visual-browser: npm run build && vite build --config references/visual-artifacts/vite.config.ts && node scripts/test-visual-artifacts-browser.mjs
scripts.predev:api: npm run build --workspace @uib/platform-core && npm run build --workspace @ui-platform/artifacts && npm run build --workspace @ui-platform/visual-artifacts
scripts.test:form-data: npm run build && vitest run tests/form-data-integration.test.ts
scripts.predev:automation-reference: npm --prefix "../UI Platform Data Services" run build --workspace @ui-platform/dataset-operations
scripts.pretest:automation: npm --prefix "../UI Platform Data Services" run build --workspace @ui-platform/dataset-operations
scripts.test:automation: npm run build && vitest run tests/trigger-workflow.test.ts tests/trigger-workflow-browser.test.ts
